meta.parties: Dona Elishamy Et Al. v. Don Julis Appuhamy

rules.statement: Parties claiming under deeds conveying fractions of a larger land corpus must be bound by the terms of their deeds, unless they can show that they have acquired title by prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: "If persons who are entitled by prescriptions of a land persist, after they have acquired that title, in conveying an undivided share of the whole land of which what they have possessed is a part; and if the persons so deriving title pass on the same title to others, then the persons claiming under that title, unless they can show that they themselves have acquired title by prescription, must be bound by the terms of their deeds"
